# tebibcloud_database (Resource)

A managed Postgres database: its own cluster, reached from the VMs of its VPC on a private address with TLS and a password. Backups are **off unless you turn them on** (`backup_enabled`): without them there is no point-in-time restore. The owner's password is only known when the database is created: it is stored in the Terraform state (marked sensitive), so keep the state encrypted. An imported database has no password (reset it with `tebib db reset-password`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tebibcloud_database" "app" {
  name = "app"
  plan = "b1.small" # see the tebibcloud_database_plans data source
  mode = "ha"

  backup_enabled        = true
  backup_retention_days = 14
}

# The owner role is "app"; connect from a VM of the same VPC.
output "database_host" {
  value = tebibcloud_database.app.host
}

output "database_password" {
  value     = tebibcloud_database.app.password
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, unique among the project's databases. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `allow_all` (Boolean) Allow every address (`0.0.0.0/0`). Needs the `db:AllowAllSources` permission.
- `allow_list` (Set of String) Addresses or CIDRs that may connect over the internet.
- `backup_enabled` (Boolean) Turn backups (and point-in-time restore) on. Default `false`. Billed for the backup storage while on.
- `backup_retention_days` (Number) Days of backups to keep, 1-30 (default 7).
- `description` (String) Description, at most 255 characters. Default: empty.
- `disk_gib` (Number) Disk per instance in GiB, at least 5 (default: the plan's). It can grow, never shrink.
- `fallback_enabled` (Boolean) A fallback port for clients that can't use direct TLS (libpq before 17). From a small fixed pool, limited per organization.
- `maintenance_window` (String) Weekly four-hour window for minor updates (UTC), e.g. `sun-02` (default).
- `mode` (String) `single` (default) or `ha`: a standby on another node with automatic failover, billed as a second instance.
- `plan` (String) Plan code from the `tebibcloud_database_plans` data source, e.g. `b1.nano` or `b1.micro`. Default: the platform's default plan (`b1.micro`). The code is checked against the plans the API offers at plan time. Changing it restarts the database.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (`p-...`). Default: the provider's `project`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `public_enabled` (Boolean) Open the database to the internet. Needs a non-empty `allow_list` (enforced before TLS and password). Postgres 17+ clients connect to `public_host` port 5432 with `sslnegotiation=direct`; others need `fallback_enabled`.
- `region` (String) Region code, e.g. `neo`. Default: the VPC's region. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `skip_final_backup` (Boolean) On destroy, don't take a final backup. Default `false`: a final backup is taken and kept for 7 days (billed). With backups on it is always taken.
- `subnet_id` (String) The subnet where the private address's two proxy pods run (default: the VPC's default subnet). Changing it replaces the database.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags (key-value pairs). IAM policies can match them. Default: none.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `version` (Number) Postgres major version, `18` (default) or `17`. Changing it replaces the database.
- `vpc_id` (String) The VPC whose VMs connect (default: the project's default VPC). Changing it replaces the database.
- `zone` (String) Zone code in the region, e.g. `neo-a`. Default: chosen by the platform. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) The private address inside the VPC (port 5432).
- `ca_certificate` (String) The database's CA certificate (PEM), for `sslrootcert`.
- `cpu_millicores` (Number) Exact CPU of an instance: 500 is half a vCPU.
- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `disk_used_bytes` (Number) Bytes used on the database disk (null until measured).
- `fallback_port` (Number) The fallback port (null while off).
- `host` (String) The platform host name: use it with `sslmode=verify-full`.
- `id` (String) Database ID (`pgdb-...`).
- `memory_mib` (Number) Memory of an instance in MiB.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The owner role's (`app`) password. Only set by the create; null after an import.
- `port` (Number) The port, 5432.
- `postgres_version` (String) The Postgres version running, e.g. `18.6`.
- `power_state` (String) `running` or `stopped`.
- `public_host` (String) The public host name (empty while the endpoint is off).
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state: `active` once ready (or `error`).
- `status_message` (String) What the platform last said about the resource.
- `trn` (String) TebibCloud resource name (TRN), for IAM policies.
- `vcpus` (Number) Whole vCPUs of an instance (the plan's CPU rounded up).

### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <database_id>, optionally with <project_id>/ in front. An imported database has no password.
terraform import tebibcloud_database.app pgdb-abc123
```
